US Sanctions Fiji-Based Man Over Corruption Linked to China

The United States has imposed sanctions on a Fiji-based individual, alleging corruption linked to China. The U.S. stated that this official paid bribes on behalf of Beijing. The sanctions target an individual operating out of Fiji, with the alleged corruption tied to China's interests.
